data.scope: One rerun after moving temporary paths into the assigned FD worktree. Three black-box CLI scenarios: standalone aiw wt is unavailable; failed delivery retains worktree and branch; successful delivery removes worktree and branch while retaining FD receipts and the single-parent FD-Source commit.
data.side_effects: Creates and removes a temporary Go CLI binary, Go build cache, copied aiw-git plugin, and temporary Git repositories/worktrees/branches/hooks/templates under the assigned FD worktree. Reads the pre-existing local Go module cache; GOPROXY=off, GOSUMDB=off, GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOWORK=off, GOENV=off, and -mod=readonly prevent downloads and module-file edits. No retained build artifacts. The previous failed system TEMP path may remain and is excluded from this authorization.
data.risk_review: Inspected revised tests/test_fd030_worktree_blackbox.py. TemporaryDirectory uses REPO as its explicit parent, so new writes are confined to the assigned worktree and cleaned by the harness. Inherited GIT_* and GO* overrides are cleared before dedicated values are applied. CLI/plugin are sourced from the current FD worktree. The first attempt failed before tests with WinError 5 under system TEMP and ran zero tests; this is the only authorized rerun after the relevant harness path fix.
